text_style_prompt: Keep the exact design, colours and pattern placement. A Chinese heavy lamellar cuirass over a padded tunic. Torso: a grid of rust-brown hardened leather and copper plates in horizontal rows, each fixed with small round iron rivets, dark gaps between plates. Across the upper chest and upper back: a band of dark hammered iron with large dome rivets. Shoulder straps of deep red lacquered leather ending in small gold ornamental clasp plaques; a pale cream stand-up collar. Long sleeves of cream-ivory quilted linen with soft folds, finished with dark teal-green cloth cuffs. Target: aged copper and leather plates with patina, scratches and edge wear, hammered iron with dents, woven linen with visible weave and stitching, glossy red lacquer. No text, no logos.
